qa_limits: Generated anatomy and costume detail can vary slightly between poses.
Preview loops restart the action; runtime transitions are not integrated.
Opponent contact is metadata; no opponent is baked into character layers.
No runtime or game repository was modified.
contact_metadata: Glove points manually annotated from full source sheets and transformed by the same registered scale/translation.
preview_review: All source and registered contact-sheet poses visually inspected; normal/3x slow GIF frame counts, order and durations decoded and verified. Live cloud-browser playback unavailable for local files due URL protocol policy.
layer_limit: Character pose is one RGBA layer, with separate complete spear. This is not an articulated per-limb rig.
target_events: Target-on-target collision occurs after throw release; target ground impact must be emitted by downstream target simulation, not this fixed sprite timeline.
